positioning_check: Short interest was 43.9K shares at the 2026-05-15 settlement, with about 1.0 days to cover (https://www.optionsanalysissuite.com/stocks/mss/short-interest, snippet only, stale). It is not crowded. The float is tiny: Jane Street's Schedule 13G (event date 2026-09-14) reports 42,744 Class A shares as 5.3%, which implies about 0.8M Class A shares outstanding after the 1-for-5 reverse split effective 2026-07-22, the second in three months (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1595888/000159588826000117/primary_doc.xml). Against that, the baseline's 20-day average volume is 5.04M shares, more than 6x the float every day, and 20-day realised vol is 157% annualised. There is no options market, so there is no skew. The stock is a high-turnover microcap that moves about 10% a day with no event.

outside_window.finding: The plan to regain compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) is due 2026-10-19, covering the delinquent FY2026 10-K and the July-quarter 10-Q. If Nasdaq accepts the plan, the company has until 2027-02-09 to file. If not, it can appeal to a Hearings Panel. This falls after the exit window (close 2026-10-09 to close 2026-10-12) and is already in the wire.

baseline_tension: There is nothing to set against the baseline. It carries no options and no skew, and its history is untrustworthy: two 8-K prints, 2024-12-16 at +13.73% and 2025-03-17 at -5.93%. The -7.78% 20-day and +6.75% 5-day run-up on a float turning over more than 6x a day is noise with no event behind it.
